questions.q: Why might a federal gas tax holiday backfire according to analysts?
o: It stimulates demand without addressing underlying supply constraints, potentially worsening price pressures.
It automatically triggers immediate interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve to counter the fiscal expansion.
It forces energy companies to immediately shut down production due to a sudden lack of operational revenue.
It causes an instant appreciation of the US dollar against all major foreign exchange crosses.
questions.e: Removing the tax lowers pump prices, which typically boosts fuel consumption. When consumption rises against constrained supply, inflationary pressures often intensify rather than recede. The other options involve institutional mechanisms not supported by the text.

questions.q: Why did Policymaker Green caution the central bank against relying solely on bond yields?

Institutional investors refuse to trade gilts when price pressures persist above the targeted central bank threshold.
Commercial banks systematically ignore market signals during periods of foreign exchange volatility.
questions.e: The official argued that market-determined borrowing costs are insufficient on their own to suppress aggregate demand. Models that rely on debt market repricing to do the heavy lifting risk underestimating independent price pressures.
